text.en: This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 2003. Amendment of Third Schedule to S 39/01.

The Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2001 i~ amended, in the Third Schedule, by repealing paragraphs 3 and 4 and by substituting the following new paragraph therefor - "3. The accounts of the Authority shall be audited annually by (a} the Auditor General; or

(b) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties required by the Companies Act (Chapter 39) to be performed by an auditor, who sh-h.ll be appointed annually by the Minister in consultation with the Auditor General: Provided that where the accounts of the Authority have been audited by a person appointed under paragraph (b), they may be verified by the Auditor General before a copy thereof is submitted to the Minister pursuant to paragraph 13.". Made this 21st. day of Muharam, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th. day of March, 2003 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
